mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) which increases risk of dronedarone-induced QT prolongation and arrhythmias; dronedarone also inhibits CYP3A4 potentially increasing bumetanide levels.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) closely, consider potassium-sparing diuretic or supplementation, monitor ECG for QT prolongation, and assess renal function regularly.
